subject: general
question: Manoj is the father of Kapil. Kapil is the only son of Maya. Kavya is the daughter of Maya. Neha is the only daughter of Kavya. How is Kapil related to Neha?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30d293553d87151fa958bad10b9696357169dd4b6d5826f3b55c8ad71758fcd3.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1765d7c10fc1d7de2e79faed815c643b6c053734cd9ceccaca041565b6aca55c.png] 

Clearly, Kapil is the maternal uncle of Neha.

Hence, ‘**Maternal uncle**’ is the correct answer.
